name: Eastern Persimmon
desc: Eastern Persimmon (Diospyros virginiana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Diospyros virginiana is a persimmon species commonly called the American persimmon, common persimmon, eastern persimmon, simmon, possumwood, possum apples, or sugar plum.
